questions: floranddecor.com is a typo domain that redirects to unrelated survey and ad sites; the retailer Floor & Decor is flooranddecor.com. Replace the batch domain with flooranddecor.com, or drop it?
emirates.com (UAE) and eurowings.com (Germany, no U.S. edition found) are foreign airlines; flixbus.com is a German-owned brand with a U.S. site. Keep them as U.S. stores?
doordashstore.com is a DoorDash-branded merchandise store run with Overture as partner. Treat it as DoorDash or as a separate seller?
Several sites (doordash, express, factory.jcrew, flybreeze, foodlion, fredmeyer, freshdirect, frysfood, evgo, expedia, eurowings) blocked scripted requests; captures may need a browser.
